guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest anomalies in the digest: latency-90 rose about 51x (z=+1002), CPU rose from 2.8 to 18.6 (+563%), and sockets and memory also increased, while its downstream productcatalogservice is essentially flat (latency-50 +20%, CPU -8.7%). Frontend latency and errors rise after it, and every worst trace passes through recommendationservice. CPU, socket and memory all moved together, so cpu vs socket is not fully separable; I chose cpu because the saturation signature (latency up with CPU up) fits best and no logs exist to confirm.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice for CPU contention or a runaway workload, then restart or scale out its replicas and add CPU limits/autoscaling. This is a non-destructive step; confirm the cause from profiling before changing anything else.
